reviewer: Independent Codex source/photo and gold-config review
decisionSummary: All seven candidates pass source/config review only for the fourteen exact US package-label references recorded below. This is not a full-range, current-formulation, availability or publication approval.

signoff.packHashBasis: Raw input-file bytes; matched before and after substantive review.
signoff.modelHashBasis: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(model), original property order, no trailing newline.
signoff.productHashBasis: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(product), original property order, no trailing newline.
signoff.attestation: Independent review signoff pinned to this exact pack, not a private-key digital signature. Any pack, evidence, image, package-scope or exclusion change requires review reconciliation.

methods: Read the source contract, project instructions and all seven complete gold product configurations.

Directly viewed and enlarged original manufacturer-printed product labels, including printed 2021 catalog pages 4, 6 and 9. Numeric tuples were manually transcribed and compared with all fourteen rows, not accepted from researcher prose or OCR alone.
Visually compared the excluded FloroClear 12 lb bonus carton and Tactical 17 lb label to confirm the conflicts remain isolated.
Independently parsed data-product_variations JSON from six saved raw official HTML pages using an HTML parser, matching twelve exact SKU identities; did not rely solely on the author's parsed JSON.
Visually checked exact TCB PXB/PXBY rows and Teflon/XTCB-8/X-Braid relationship on the original 2021 manufacturer catalog page.
Inspected the saved original PDF metadata and text/page identity. It has 102 pages, was created/modified March 26, 2021, and carries the US distributor address.
Reopened current public official product pages with normal web access to check construction/edition context; recorded inaccessible pages rather than treating them as fresh verification.
Hashed 85 evidence-manifest files, all visual row evidence and all seven local hero images; inspected image family and exact-package caption honesty.
Independently checked legacy brand/model/material/row-ID identity, mainline roles, exclusions, exact defaults and all fourteen example setups against the existing calculator.

Rendered all seven gold configurations in memory with the shared gold template to verify chart/image captions, numeric precision, expected rows and absence of undefined/NaN/generic stock text. No output pages or shared files were written.

remainingGates.action: Resolve permission or other appropriate publication basis for the third-party-hosted photographs and manufacturer artwork. Provenance alone does not grant rights.

limitations: Source/photo identity was visually and textually corroborated, not forensically authenticated or physically measured.
Unknown production years remain unknown. A current official SKU match is not proof of unchanged historical formulation or current retail stock.
No live-byte re-download comparison for every original photo or the catalog was performed; local evidence hashes establish the exact artifacts reviewed.
No broad regression sweep, deployment, live page review or image-rights determination is claimed.
